tiles.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D square tile atlas for MollyMine, cozy cartoon mining game. Generate one landscape 1536x1024 PNG with an EXACT 3-column 2-row grid, each cell 512x512, zero gutters, zero outer margins. All six cells fully opaque and fill their square edge to edge. Front-facing flat cross-section texture, no perspective. Top row: THREE clearly distinct variations of warm ochre compact soil, colors #b47642 #cf9455 #845335. Soft large rounded earthen masses, only 2 to 4 broad gentle grooves and 2 to 3 pebble specks per cell. Keep brightness consistent across the three variations. Much simpler than detailed cracked stone: smooth painterly cartoon soil, broad quiet areas, tiny detail forbidden. Bottom left: excavated tunnel background, very dark muted warm earth #433b30, faint broad soft earthen shapes, low contrast, empty interior, absolutely no rocks/objects/cracks suggesting obstacles. Bottom middle: indestructible bedrock, dark blue charcoal #1b303b #38505b, 3 to 5 massive interlocking rock forms with clear heavy block contours, markedly darker and sturdier than soil. Bottom right: SECOND distinct excavated tunnel background matching bottom left. All tiles intended to be displayed at 64x64 pixels, prioritise clear silhouettes and excellent readability. Consistent hand-painted casual mobile game style, gentle top-left light, matte surfaces, flat orthographic artwork. Texture edges should repeat without bold seams or square borders. NO outlined tile frame, no bevel rim, no floor, no side walls, no environment scene, no characters, no grass, no roots, no minerals, no gems, no fossils, no gold, no treasure, no glowing areas, no visible loot. No typography, labels, numbers, grid strokes, watermark or presentation board. Only the exact usable six-cell texture atlas.

refinement.prompt: Edit target: the supplied production terrain atlas. Change ONLY the color/brightness of the TOP ROW three soil tiles. All three top row tiles MUST have the SAME warm ochre average brightness and SAME color palette as the CURRENT TOP LEFT tile. Darken the top-middle cell slightly to match top-left, and brighten the top-right cell substantially to match top-left. These are three variants of the same soil, not three biome or hardness types. Keep their three different broad shapes and pebble placements. Aim for all their edge colors matching so the soil reads continuous when placed randomly at 64x64. Preserve the entire bottom row EXACTLY: two dark tunnel tiles and blue charcoal bedrock. Preserve 1536x1024 dimensions and exact 3 columns x 2 rows layout, zero gutters and margins. Preserve simple soft hand-painted cartoon style, no new fine details, no new text, no labels, no borders. Output corrected opaque PNG atlas only.

rock.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production-ready transparent PNG rock sprite for a cozy 2D mining game, displayed in one 64x64 tile. Square 1024x1024 canvas. Exactly one centered squat rounded boulder, occupying roughly 85% of canvas width and 80% of height, with a narrow consistent transparent margin. Genuine transparent alpha background. Flat front-facing orthographic side view, not isometric. Friendly hand-painted mobile game illustration, warm sage-gray palette #8b9e91, broad smooth chunky silhouette, only 4 or 5 large simple facets, gentle highlight at upper left and dark self-shading at lower right. Clean slightly darker outline separating the rock from ochre soil and dark tunnels. Bottom roughly flat so it looks grounded. Keep shapes extremely clear when shrunk to 64x64, no noisy texture, no tiny cracks, no small pebbles, no moss, no face, no gold, no mineral inclusions, no gems. NO cast shadow, no glow, no halo, no scenery, no floor, no text, no watermark, no other sprites. This is a movable falling obstacle and must look solid and heavy.
